headline: Four Loans Under One Roof Hides Credit Risk; Banks Must Report Wealth-Management Working Capital from October | Business
summary: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission said working-capital reporting covers individuals and businesses. Banks will add reporting on working capital for individuals buying stocks and other financial products from October.
why: The Financial Supervisory Commission oversees Taiwan's banks and financial institutions, and its reporting rules shape how lenders track credit exposure.
